Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main damage source. When you see him cast it, dodge beyond the blade’s edge or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately instead of hesitating over which direction to take. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his increased healing can turn a duel around, so create distance and wait out its duration.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox’s main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps and armor early. Dead Man’s Plate or Randuin’s Omen can also help Darius stick to Aatrox by slowing him while you stay close. If healing from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender can turn a long duel around, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Aatrox.fight: Look to trade just after Aatrox uses his empowered attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. Dodge the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade while baiting out Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then pull him in with Darius E Apprehend. Once close, weave attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing.
Aatrox.laning: In the early game, farm without giving Aatrox a kill. Freeze the lane near your side so he has to walk up for minions, creating chances to fight within Darius E Apprehend range. If you push the lane, get vision first, since Darius has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks.
Aatrox.combo: After Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius W Crippling Strike right after a basic attack to fit in an extra attack, and step back as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade. To execute, stack Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack, then finish with Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Aatrox.escape: The opening to engage comes right after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is used. If you use Darius E Apprehend first, he can dodge it with his dash, so wait until you see him use his mobility before pulling him in. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave the area first to avoid being pulled back, then decide whether to fight.
Aatrox.phase: Aatrox can snowball hard from an early lead, so avoid giving him kills and keep farming; the matchup improves as the game goes on. Darius is strong through the mid game, but it becomes harder to engage in standard teamfights late, so secure a lane advantage while you are strong.
Aatrox.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal and survive. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to start a chain with its cooldown reset.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse is pulled back, and that damage increases the more health you have lost. If cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora; if you are below half health, retreat before it snaps back. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving it slows you, so either get out beforehand or commit to fighting inside.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so buy Mercury's Treads first and build magic resistance with Force of Nature. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration can turn a long fight around, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Since Darius E Apprehend has armor penetration, armor penetration focused items are a lower priority.
Aurora.fight: While Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, or R Between Worlds is still available, she can dodge Darius E Apprehend with a mobility ability if you cast it first. Bait out a mobility ability, then pull her in with Darius E Apprehend and weave attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing.
Aurora.laning: Keep the lane near your side so Aurora has to walk up for minions, then start a fight within Darius E Apprehend range right after she uses a mobility ability. If you are low on health after being hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, retreat to avoid its return damage. If you push the lane, get vision before moving forward, since Darius has no escape mobility.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora’s mobility is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To go for a kill, stack Hemorrhage in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. During Aurora W Across the Veil’s stealth, don’t rush Darius R Noxian Guillotine; wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.escape: If either Aurora W Across the Veil or E The Weirding is down, wait until you have accounted for her remaining mobility before engaging. The opening to catch her with Darius E Apprehend comes when both abilities are down and Aurora R Between Worlds is unavailable. Counterattack when Aurora uses her leap to engage and fails to get a kill with it.
Aurora.phase: While you are strong through the mid game, secure a lane advantage when Aurora’s mobility is down.
Aurora.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Pick off a target you can certainly kill with Darius R Noxian Guillotine to aim for a cooldown reset. If an ally dies, Aurora’s leap ability may also reset, so don’t leave a low health ally behind when retreating.

Akali.watch: Avoiding the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip is most important. If it marks you, her second dash will follow even if you try to escape, so be ready for her to re-engage if you are hit. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit deals more damage based on your missing health.
Akali.build: Buy Mercury's Treads early against Akali’s damage, then build magic resistance with Force of Nature. Also get health to prepare for the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution. Since Darius E Apprehend has armor penetration, penetration focused items are a lower priority.
Akali.fight: Don’t cast Darius E Apprehend first while Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution is available. Pull her in with Darius E Apprehend after she comes out of the shroud to attack or uses mobility to escape, then weave attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing.
Akali.laning: Freeze the lane near your side so Akali has to walk into Darius E Apprehend range to farm. If you push the lane, get vision before moving forward.
Akali.combo: For a short trade after Akali’s mobility is down, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → step back and use Darius Q Decimate. To go for an execute, stack Darius P Hemorrhage in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t rush Darius R Noxian Guillotine before you have enough stacks.
Akali.escape: If one of Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution is down, she can still escape with the others, so don’t rush your engage. In particular, look for a window before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back: use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to close the gap, then catch her with Darius E Apprehend right after she uses mobility. Avoid the slow from Akali Q Five Point Strike before closing in.
Akali.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies in with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Finish off a target you can certainly kill with Darius R Noxian Guillotine to chain cooldown resets. If you can’t secure that kind of terrain, choose side lane pressure over a front to back teamfight.

Camille.watch: Camille can engage from a distance and stun you when Camille E Hookshot connects with a wall, so stay away from walls. The moment her hook connects with a wall, you can interrupt the dash with Darius E Apprehend. Don’t use a response ability as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages; if trapped, wait out the zone’s duration, then counterattack.
Camille.build: Camille’s main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor with Dead Man’s Plate or Randuin’s Omen. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep can turn a fight around, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; engage once the shield is gone. You can interrupt Camille E Hookshot’s dash with Darius E Apprehend, so look for the moment her hook connects with a wall. If Camille’s mobility is down, pull her in with Darius E Apprehend and weave attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage.
Camille.laning: Freeze the lane near your side so Camille has to walk up for minions, then pressure her within Darius E Apprehend range. Camille E Hookshot starts from a wall, so don’t let yourself get pushed toward one. If you push the lane, get vision before going in, since Darius has limited escape options.
Camille.combo: When Camille’s mobility is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing. To execute, stack Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack, then finish with Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Camille.escape: Your chance to fight comes right after you dodge the stun from Camille E Hookshot or interrupt its dash with Darius E Apprehend. Even if Camille E Hookshot is down, she can still escape with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, so track both abilities. In particular, before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back, use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to close the gap, then catch her with Darius E Apprehend.
Camille.phase: Camille is weak early before her first core item, so take lane priority and deny her farm before then. From the mid game onward, Camille destroys side lane turrets quickly, so don’t leave a side lane unattended. It becomes harder for Darius to engage in front to back teamfights late, so secure the lead you gained during your strong window.
Camille.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal and survive. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine first on a target you can certainly kill to chain cooldown resets.

Chogath.watch: When you see the ground marker for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, immediately walk to the side to dodge the knock-up. Move to the side to avoid the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and don't stand in the line behind minions where Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes will pass through. If you are below half health, get out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.
Chogath.build: Buy Mercury's Treads first and build Force of Nature to mitigate the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Darius has no mobility, so silence and knock-ups can easily interrupt your engages; get tenacity early.
Chogath.fight: Approach when Cho'Gath misses Q Rupture or uses it on the wave. Cho'Gath has no mobility, so pull him in with Darius E Apprehend, then stay in range with basic attacks and the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike while stacking P Hemorrhage. Step back before using Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and heals you.
Chogath.laning: Keep the wave near your side and look for Darius E Apprehend when Cho'Gath walks up to farm. If you push the wave, secure vision first to prepare for ganks.
Chogath.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. When you can secure the kill, stack P Hemorrhage and finish with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Chogath.escape: The opening to engage is right after Cho'Gath misses Q Rupture or uses it on the wave. Approach from outside the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and if silenced, walk out before trying to cast a spell. Cho'Gath has no mobility, so once you catch him, stay in range with Darius E Apprehend and W Crippling Strike.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he stacks, so pressure him early and limit his time to scale. Darius has a harder time engaging head-on in late-game fights, so build your lane advantage while you can.
Chogath.teamfight: In tight spaces, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Q Decimate to hit and heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to try to reset its cooldown.

Fiora.watch: When Fiora dashes toward a vital with Q Lunge, stand on the opposite side to narrow her angle. If Fiora hits you with R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block one side's vitals.
Fiora.build: Build Plated Steelcaps and armor early against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. If healing from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge turns extended fights around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Armor cannot block the true damage from vitals, and Fiora R Grand Challenge deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of stacking too much health.
Fiora.fight: Bait out Fiora Q Lunge, then wait until Fiora W Riposte is also down before pulling her in with Darius E Apprehend. Stack Darius P Hemorrhage with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back and hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Don't chase recklessly after a short trade.
Fiora.laning: Freeze the wave on your side so Fiora has to come within Darius E Apprehend range to farm. Stand opposite the vital on your body and look for the moment Fiora dashes toward it to counterattack. If you push the wave, secure vision first because Darius has a hard time escaping ganks.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora Q Lunge and W Riposte are down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. For an execution, stack Darius P Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Don't use Darius Q Decimate while right next to her; step back so the blade hits.
Fiora.escape: The opening to engage is right after Fiora Q Lunge is used. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, pull her in with Darius E Apprehend to stop her escape and combo her. If Fiora W Riposte is still available, hold Darius E Apprehend and sidestep Riposte's hit.
Fiora.phase: Build your lane advantage during your strong window through the mid game.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora hits you with R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall so she can't reach all four vitals. In tight spaces, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to hit and heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to reset its cooldown and seek chained kills.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the main source of Dr. Mundo's damage, E Blunt Force Trauma. Healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper can turn a long duel around, so once you have resistances, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
DrMundo.fight: When Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, catch him with Darius E Apprehend and stack Darius P Hemorrhage with a mix of basic attacks and abilities. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions, and step back slightly when using Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and deals damage while healing you. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don't force a kill.
DrMundo.laning: Keep the wave on your side to set up Darius E Apprehend when Dr. Mundo walks up to farm. Keep minions between you to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and after a trade, step on the canister Mundo drops to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction. If you push the wave, secure vision first given Darius's vulnerability to ganks.
DrMundo.combo: After Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, take a short trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. When looking for a kill, stack P Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine. Don't use Darius Q Decimate right next to him; adjust your spacing so the blade hits.
DrMundo.escape: Engage with Darius E Apprehend when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you catch him, stay in range with the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike. Don't force a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available.
DrMundo.phase: Build your lane advantage through the mid game, but look for a kill or force an objective while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.teamfight: In tight spaces, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Q Decimate to hit and heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to reset its cooldown and start chaining kills.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his basic attack and silences, so don't engage while it is active. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, don't stay close for long; leave its range. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity right after activation, so delay Darius E Apprehend by half a beat. If you are below half health, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen can slow Garen after you catch him and help with the chase. If healing from Garen P Perseverance turns fights around, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Garen.fight: Start trading right after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack is used. Pull him in with Darius E Apprehend, then stack Darius P Hemorrhage with a mix of basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, and step back to hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate. When Garen E Judgment spins, leave its range rather than staying close and taking damage.
Garen.laning: Keep the wave on your side to set up Darius E Apprehend when Garen walks up to farm. Limit the time Garen has to stack W Courage, but if you push the wave, secure vision first to prepare for ganks.
Garen.combo: For a standard trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. If Garen activates W Courage, wait for the brief shield and tenacity to expire before using Darius E Apprehend. For an execution, stack P Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Garen.escape: The opening to engage is right after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack is used on a minion or expires. When Garen activates W Courage, hold Darius E Apprehend and use it half a beat later. Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you catch him, stay in range with the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike.
Garen.phase: Pressure Garen and build your advantage during your strong window through the mid game. You'll fall further behind as Garen stacks W Courage, and Darius also has a harder time engaging head-on in late-game fights.
Garen.teamfight: In tight spaces, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend, overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to hit, and heal to stay alive. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to try to reset its cooldown.

Gangplank.watch: When Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, avoid its blast radius. Only destroy it when you can do so from outside the radius.
Gangplank.build: Rush Plated Steelcaps and armor against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. If you struggle to stay on him once you engage, consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy's healing turns extended fights around, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Gangplank.fight: Right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, engage and trade if there are no other primed kegs nearby. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend, then build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike. Step back as you hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to deal damage and heal.
Gangplank.laning: Keep the wave on your side so Gangplank has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to last-hit. Don't stand where two Gangplank E Powder Kegs overlap, and back away if a primed keg is nearby. If you push the wave, secure vision first to prepare for a gank.
Gangplank.combo: After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To go for a kill, add another basic attack after Apprehend to build P Hemorrhage stacks, hit with the blade of Q, then use Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Gangplank.escape: Engage when Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and nearby Gangplank E Powder Kegs are not primed. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you get a chance to catch him, use Darius E Apprehend and the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike to stay on him.
Gangplank.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and hit them with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Build P Hemorrhage stacks, then use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to reset its cooldown and chain into another kill.

Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit on both the outward and return paths, so step out of its path. Avoid direct fights when Gnar P Rage Gene's rage bar is full and transformation is near. Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! stuns targets knocked into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one.
Gnar.build: Gnar's main damage is physical, so rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor first. Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen also help slow Gnar while you stay on him. Keep in mind that the magic and max-health-based damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop can't be countered with armor or health alone.
Gnar.fight: Fight Gnar while he's Mini, especially right after he changes from Mega back to Mini. Bait out Gnar E Hop / Crunch, then pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with a mix of basic attacks and abilities. Create distance right after he becomes Mega and wait out the transformation.
Gnar.laning: Keep the wave on your side so Gnar has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to last-hit. If Mini Gnar keeps poking you at range and you can't engage, farm near your turret and wait for his transformation cycle. If you push the wave, secure vision first, since Darius has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks.
Gnar.combo: When Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Step back as you hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to deal damage and heal. To go for an execution, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Gnar.phase: While you're strong through mid game, use Mini Gnar's weak periods and the moments right after his transformation ends to gain lane advantage.
Gnar.teamfight: Position yourself to avoid being stunned by Gnar R GNAR! knocking you into a wall, and don't meet Mega Gnar head-on right after he transforms. When you have a safe angle to engage, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and hit them with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine first on a target you can definitely kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Illaoi.watch: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, and if it hits, fight back when you can. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, don't bunch up; create distance for its duration. Illaoi heals near tentacles with P Prophet of an Elder God, so don't keep fighting there.
Illaoi.build: Rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor against Illaoi's main damage. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on max health, so don't stack too much health alone. Buy Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter her sustained healing.
Illaoi.fight: Pull Illaoi in with Darius E Apprehend and fight right after she uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Use Darius W Crippling Strike to stay on her, and step back as you hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to deal damage and heal.
Illaoi.laning: Freeze the wave on your side to make Illaoi step up to last-hit. Stay away from walls and tentacles, and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. If you push the wave, secure vision before applying pressure.
Illaoi.combo: For a short trade after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To execute, build P Hemorrhage stacks with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Illaoi.escape: Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is her means of mobility, so its use creates an opening to engage. If there's distance between you, close it with Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then pull her in with Darius E Apprehend. Start the fight only after you've also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don't bunch up before Illaoi R Leap of Faith; when she uses her ultimate, spread out and wait out its duration. If you don't have time to destroy the tentacles, draw Illaoi away from the walls. If you can fight in tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and hit them with the blade of Darius Q Decimate, then use Darius R Noxian Guillotine first on a target you can definitely kill.

Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals heavy true damage, so sidestep when she casts it. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can't target Gwen from outside the mist, so go in or wait for it to end before using Darius R Noxian Guillotine. To reduce healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts, stay outside her basic attack range.
Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen's main damage, and consider Force of Nature after Mercury's Treads. Armor is also valuable against the physical damage from her basic attacks, but no resistance can mitigate the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts becomes a problem in extended fights, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Gwen.laning: Keep the wave on your side so you can pressure Gwen within Darius E Apprehend range when she steps up to farm. Trade before Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks build up; don't engage if they're fully stacked. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash comes back often near large minion waves, so draw her to an area without minions if you want to catch her.
Gwen.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. To execute, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Step back half a step as you hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate, and use Darius R Noxian Guillotine once Darius P Hemorrhage has enough stacks.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her only means of mobility, so its use creates an opening to pull her in with Darius E Apprehend. If Gwen R Needlework's slow is also down, there's less risk of being slowed while closing the distance.
Gwen.teamfight: In tight terrain, you can sustain through a fight by pulling multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and hitting them with the blade of Darius Q Decimate. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and when targeting Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist, go in or wait for the mist to end. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine first on a target you can definitely kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so step back when a minion is about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Build armor first to withstand Irelia’s main damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Irelia Q Bladesurge’s healing can turn a long fight, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Irelia.fight: As soon as Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, pull her in with Darius E Apprehend and fight. Mix attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage, and step back so Darius Q Decimate hits with the blade, dealing damage and healing you.
Irelia.laning: Keep low-health minions from sitting between you and Irelia to limit Irelia Q Bladesurge’s approach paths. Keep the lane on your side so Irelia has to walk up to farm, then pressure her within Darius E Apprehend range when Irelia Q Bladesurge is down.
Irelia.combo: After Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate for a short trade. To execute, stack Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack, then finish with Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Irelia.escape: The moment Irelia Q Bladesurge is down is your chance to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, pull her in with Darius E Apprehend to limit her chance to escape.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia, since Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact in team fights. In tight spaces, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the hits from Darius Q Decimate’s blade to sustain yourself. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine first on a target you can reliably kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t use basic attacks or Darius W Crippling Strike. Your attacks will be negated, and Counter Strike’s recast damage is high, so step outside its stun range and wait for it to end. When Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike to engage, check whether Jax E Counter Strike is active.
Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the foundation of his damage, so prioritize considering items that reduce attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so don’t invest only in health.
Jax.fight: Start trading after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also just used, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and mix attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. Step back so Darius Q Decimate hits with the blade, dealing damage and healing you.
Jax.laning: Keep the lane on your side so Jax has to walk up to farm, then pressure him while Jax E Counter Strike is down. If you’ve pushed the lane, secure vision before going in, since Darius has no mobility spell.
Jax.combo: Once Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To execute, stack Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Space Darius Q Decimate so its blade hits, and don’t use Darius R Noxian Guillotine too early.
Jax.escape: Jax Q Leap Strike is his mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your window to catch him with Darius E Apprehend. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, first leave its stun range and wait for it to end. Engage with Darius E Apprehend after both abilities are down.
Jax.phase: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t overcommit.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group up around him; wait for the stun to end. Then catch him with Darius E Apprehend. In tight spaces, pull in multiple enemies and overlap the hits from Darius Q Decimate’s blade. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce has his cannon, watch for ranged poke. If Jayce uses Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate to place a gate, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow, so dodge sideways out of its line. When he has his hammer, prepare for his leap and knockback, and watch for the moment after he uses Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. However, this won’t stop the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, so dodge sideways. Since Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on your max health, build some movement speed to leave the targeted area instead of stacking too much health.
Jayce.fight: As soon as Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast’s leap is down, close the distance and pull him in with Darius E Apprehend. If Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate’s knockback is also down, you have a chance to stick to him and fight. Mix attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage, and step back so Darius Q Decimate hits with the blade.
Jayce.laning: Against Jayce with his cannon, move side to side while farming. If your health is low, don’t overstay; clear the wave and then return. Freeze the lane on your side so Jayce has to walk up to farm, and fight within Darius E Apprehend range when his leap is down. If you’ve pushed the lane, secure vision first so the immobile Darius doesn’t get caught by a gank.
Jayce.combo: For a short trade after Jayce’s leap is down, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. When you can execute, stack Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack, then finish with Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t use Darius Q Decimate right next to Jayce; keep enough distance for the blade to hit.
Jayce.escape: The moment Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast’s leap is down is your window to engage. If Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate’s knockback is also used, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend, then slow him with Darius W Crippling Strike to maintain the distance.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively while dodging his poke.
Jayce.teamfight: Instead of diving into the backline head-on, look for the moment Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast’s leap is down. In tight spaces, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the hits from Darius Q Decimate’s blade to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to chain cooldown resets.

KSante.watch: If you’re hit by consecutive casts of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, the next Q can pull and stun you, so step out of range. K'Sante W Path Maker grants unstoppable and damage reduction while charging, so hold Darius E Apprehend and dodge to the side of his dash path. Watch for K'Sante R All Out, and don’t keep a wall behind you.
KSante.build: Move Plated Steelcaps up in your build and get armor to withstand K'Sante’s main damage. Adding Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen can slow K'Sante while he’s on you. K'Sante W Path Maker’s true damage can’t be resisted, so consider health too. If you’re often caught in crowd control, prioritize tenacity over armor.
KSante.fight: Don’t commit your attacks while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging; dodge the dash, then fight. Right after K'Sante uses a mobility ability, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and mix attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. When K'Sante R All Out is active, K'Sante becomes temporarily more vulnerable, so focus your damage on him, but don’t tank his increased damage and healing alone for too long.
KSante.laning: Hold the lane on your side so K'Sante has to walk into Darius E Apprehend range to farm. If you’ve pushed the lane, secure vision first so the immobile Darius doesn’t get caught by a gank.
KSante.escape: K'Sante W Path Maker, K'Sante E Footwork, and K'Sante R All Out are mobility abilities, so don’t use Darius E Apprehend just because one of them is down. If you need to close the distance, narrow it with Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then catch him with Darius E Apprehend.
KSante.teamfight: In tight spaces, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the hits from Darius Q Decimate’s blade to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to start a chain of cooldown resets. If you have to fight for a long time while K'Sante R All Out is active, make sure at least one teammate has a source of Grievous Wounds, and don’t let K'Sante keep hitting multiple people.

Kennen.watch: When Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid the third mark and stun. Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken behind minions, and avoid standing close to allies when Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom is active.
Kennen.build: Buy Mercury's Treads first to counter Kennen's damage and stun. Then get Force of Nature for magic resistance and movement speed.
Kennen.fight: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and fight. Slow him with Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back with Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade and heal.
Kennen.laning: Keep the lane on your side so Kennen has to come forward to farm. Usually, block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken behind minions, exposing yourself only briefly to last-hit.
Kennen.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To execute, stack P Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack, then Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Kennen.escape: Engage after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and before Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice. If he has two marks, back off until they expire, then look for an opening to use Darius E Apprehend.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom cannot hit multiple allies, and use vision to check where Kennen might enter. In narrow terrain, pull several enemies with Darius E Apprehend and hit them with the blade of Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to start a reset chain.

Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows you and reduces your armor and magic resistance. Kayle can heal and gain movement speed with Kayle W Celestial Blessing to escape, so catch her with Darius E Apprehend after she uses it. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, do not unload your damage; wait it out with the crowd control from Darius E Apprehend.
Kayle.build: Kayle deals mostly magic damage, so buy Mercury's Treads first, then increase your magic resistance with Force of Nature. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing turns fights around, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Kayle.laning: Freeze the lane on your side and catch Kayle with Darius E Apprehend when she steps up to farm, building a lead in CS and experience. If you push the lane, secure vision and look for a gank with your jungler when Kayle has difficulty escaping.
Kayle.combo: For a basic trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. Step back with Q Decimate so the blade hits and you deal damage and heal. To execute, stack with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine, then finish her after the damage immunity from Kayle R Divine Judgment ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no dash, so engage with Darius E Apprehend after dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast or after she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Apply the forced movement and slow from E Apprehend before she escapes with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing, then deal your damage.
Kayle.teamfight: Do not let a front-to-back team fight drag on while Kayle attacks from behind. Create a path to reach her from the flank or outside vision, alongside your allies' crowd control.

Kled.watch: If Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, beware of the fourth basic attack's max health damage. Back off and re-engage so you do not take all four attacks with increased attack speed. If you are caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before it pulls you in.
Kled.build: Build armor first and prioritize Plated Steelcaps against Kled's main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. Then consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen; prioritize tenacity if crowd control is getting you killed. Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal max health damage, so avoid choices that only stack a lot of health.
Kled.fight: After Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and fight. Slow him with Darius W Crippling Strike, and mix basic attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. If you are about to take all four empowered attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies, create distance first.
Kled.laning: Keep the lane on your side and hold Kled in Darius E Apprehend range when he steps up to farm. Kled remounts when his courage fills after dismounting Skaarl, so if you cannot kill him, create distance and keep pressuring him away from farming.
Kled.combo: After Kled's mobility is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Step back with Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get damage and healing. To execute, stack with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then finish him.
Kled.escape: If you engage just because Kled E Jousting is down, he can escape with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, so check whether he still has another mobility ability. In particular, the window to use Darius E Apprehend is just after Kled E Jousting is down and before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back. It is also less risky to stick to him and fight after Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope misses or you dodge its pull.
Kled.phase: Build a lane advantage during your strong window through mid game, but Kled also gets weaker if the game goes long without you giving him an early lead.
Kled.teamfight: Get vision on the flanks because Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from outside vision. In narrow terrain, pull several enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade hits from Darius Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Malphite.watch: If you are hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so do not start a trade right afterward. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces your attack speed, so engage after it is used. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so Darius E Apprehend cannot interrupt it.
Malphite.build: Buy Mercury's Treads first to counter the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force, then increase your magic resistance with Force of Nature. Darius E Apprehend already has armor penetration, so items focused on penetration are a lower priority.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then pressure him with Darius P Hemorrhage to keep the shield from regenerating before you whittle down his health. Do not start a fight while Malphite Q Seismic Shard has hit you or Malphite E Ground Slam is still available. If Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and stack Hemorrhage.
Malphite.laning: If you push the lane, secure vision first because Darius has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks.
Malphite.combo: After Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down and you have broken P Granite Shield, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. Use W right after a basic attack, and step back slightly with Q so the blade hits and you get damage and healing. To execute, stack with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine.
Malphite.escape: The moment after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down is your chance to engage with Darius E Apprehend. You cannot interrupt R with Darius E Apprehend, so do not throw E out first and waste it. If Malphite E Ground Slam is down too, you can stack Hemorrhage with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike without suffering the attack speed reduction.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force does not knock up several of you at once, and avoid grouping when Malphite is out of sight. Counterattack as soon as R is down. In narrow terrain, pull several enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade hits from Q Decimate. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, it's easy to get hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise in quick succession, so create distance by moving straight back. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after hitting you three times, so trade briefly and back off; don't stay close once it's active. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, you can't get help from allies, so don't enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.fight: Before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, trade only once or twice, then back off. If you get a chance for a longer fight, use Darius W Crippling Strike's slow and Darius E Apprehend's pull to keep him close, then mix attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage. Don't commit your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield appears; focus him once it wears down or converts into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Keep the wave on your side and look for Darius E Apprehend when Mordekaiser steps up to last-hit. Keep your distance directly in front of him so you don't get pulled by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and then hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. If you push the wave, secure vision before moving forward since Darius has no mobility ability.
Mordekaiser.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Step back as you cast Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing. To go for a kill, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then finish him.
Mordekaiser.escape: Engage after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and there's no risk of being trapped alone in Mordekaiser R Realm of Death. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have an opening, close the gap with Darius R Noxian Guillotine and catch him with Darius E Apprehend.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can't pull several of you in at once. If you can pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend in a narrow area, overlap the hits with Darius Q Decimate's blade to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill first to aim for a reset.

Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike gets more threatening as it gains stacks, so keep him from farming last hits freely from the early game. Nasus W Wither reduces your movement and attack speed, so don't push deep alone while W is available. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting unless you have a clear advantage and let its duration run out.
Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus's main damage, Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so prioritize staying off its area. Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing to stack a lot of health alone.
Nasus.fight: When Nasus walks up to last-hit, pull him with Darius E Apprehend, stack Darius P Hemorrhage with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back to hit him with Darius Q Decimate's blade. Don't force an extended fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Keep the wave on your side so Nasus has to enter Darius E Apprehend's range to last-hit with Q Siphoning Strike. Don't push the wave under Nasus's turret and let him stack Q freely. Nasus has no escape besides Flash, so calling for a jungle gank when the wave is pulled toward you is also a good option.
Nasus.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To execute him, stack Darius P Hemorrhage with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Don't cast Darius Q Decimate right next to Nasus; step back to hit him with the blade.
Nasus.escape: Look for an opportunity to engage with Darius E Apprehend when Nasus W Wither is down. Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so if Darius E Apprehend catches him, it's hard for him to get away before using Flash. Conversely, avoid engaging alone while W Wither is available or R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.phase: Stop Nasus from stacking Q Siphoning Strike early and secure your lead through mid game. Nasus gets stronger as the game goes on, while Darius has a hard time engaging from the front in late-game team fights.
Nasus.teamfight: Keep your distance instead of facing Nasus head-on while R Fury of the Sands is active. In a narrow area, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the hits with Darius Q Decimate's blade to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to chain resets.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces Darius's armor and slows him, so move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to prevent Olaf from picking it up. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so relying on armor alone when your health is low is dangerous. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't try to hold him with Darius E Apprehend; create distance instead.
Olaf.build: Move Plated Steelcaps up in your build and get armor first to prepare for Olaf's physical damage. Then use Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen to slow him when fighting up close. Olaf E Reckless Swing can't be reduced by resistances, so your total health and healing from Darius Q Decimate are also important.
Olaf.fight: Olaf is strong early, so don't recklessly stay in a long fight. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, pull him with Darius E Apprehend and stack Darius P Hemorrhage with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike. Step back as you cast Darius Q Decimate to hit him with the blade and heal.
Olaf.laning: Keep the wave on your side and look for an angle to use Darius E Apprehend when Olaf steps up to farm. Move opposite the direction where Olaf Q Undertow lands to make it harder for him to pick up the axe. If you push the wave, secure vision before moving forward since Darius has no mobility ability.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate for a short trade. If you can execute him, build enough Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Step half a pace back as you cast Darius Q Decimate to hit him with the blade.
Olaf.escape: The opportunity to trade with Darius E Apprehend comes when Olaf has to take a longer path to pick up the axe from Q Undertow. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance; as soon as it ends, catch him with Darius E Apprehend's forced movement and slow. Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you catch him, you can use Darius W Crippling Strike to maintain range.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so avoid giving up a kill and don't force fights.
Olaf.teamfight: Darius has a hard time reaching the back line from the front, so look for an opportunity to pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend in a narrow area. Then hit several enemies with Darius Q Decimate's blade to heal and stay in the fight. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to aim for a reset.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so be careful not to enter its range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he's facing, so don't unload your damage from the front; wait for it to end or move around to his side. When you see the landing marker for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.
Pantheon.build: Since Pantheon's main damage is physical, consider Plated Steelcaps first, then add armor with Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choosing to stack a lot of health alone. Darius E Apprehend has armor penetration, so items that focus their value on penetration are a lower priority.
Pantheon.fight: Pull Pantheon with Darius E Apprehend and fight right after his W Shield Vault is down. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait out its frontal block or move to his side to deal damage. Mix basic attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage, and hit him with Darius Q Decimate's blade to heal so you can keep fighting longer.
Pantheon.laning: If you push the wave, secure vision before moving forward.
Pantheon.combo: Step back as you cast Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade and get its damage and healing. To execute him, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then finish him.
Pantheon.escape: Right after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down is an opportunity to use Darius E Apprehend, but Pantheon can escape with R Grand Starfall if it's still available. In particular, look for an opening before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up; if needed, close the gap with Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then catch him with Darius E Apprehend.
Pantheon.teamfight: In a narrow area, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the hits with Darius Q Decimate's blade to heal. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking you from the front, wait for it to end or get to his side. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can definitely kill to reset and go for another kill.

Ornn.watch: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture leaves a pillar that also counts as collision terrain for Ornn E Searing Charge, so move away from walls and pillars toward open ground. If Ornn W Bellows Breath’s final flame makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends. Dodge the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and also move off the straight line between the spirit and Ornn, where he can headbutt it back.
Ornn.build: Ornn deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so don’t invest only in one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. Since Darius has no mobility and can be locked down by Ornn’s crowd control, consider tenacity before resistances. Darius E Apprehend has armor penetration, so items that heavily prioritize penetration are lower priority.
Ornn.fight: Don’t use Darius E Apprehend first while Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, don’t fight forward; wait for the effect to end, then look for an opening.
Ornn.laning: Hold the wave near your side so Ornn has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. If Ornn tries to forge an item in lane, stick to him and attack to interrupt it. If you push the wave, secure vision first because Darius has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks.
Ornn.combo: After Ornn’s mobility is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → step half a pace back while using Darius Q Decimate. To look for an execute, build stacks in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If you use Darius Q Decimate right next to Ornn, you lose the blade damage and heal, so create the right distance.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, Ornn can still escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so check whether his other mobility is available. In particular, after Ornn has used Ornn E Searing Charge and before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back, you have an opportunity to catch him with Darius E Apprehend. Keep your distance while Brittle, then engage after the effect ends.
Ornn.teamfight: Dodge the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and stay off the line where Ornn can headbutt it back. In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal and sustain through the fight. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health, and don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.fight: Fight by pulling Poppy with Darius E Apprehend as soon as Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait before going in with Darius R Noxian Guillotine. During the fight, mix basic attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage, and step back as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade and heal.
Poppy.laning: Hold the wave near your side so Poppy has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. Avoid standing with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage to dodge the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it before Poppy to deny her shield.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius W Crippling Strike immediately after a basic attack, and create a little distance for Darius Q Decimate so you hit with the blade. To execute, build stacks in this order, then finish: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Poppy.escape: The moment Poppy has used Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to engage. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, close the gap with Darius R Noxian Guillotine and pull her with Darius E Apprehend.
Poppy.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine first on a target you can certainly kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn’s P Harrier mark appears on you, back out of range to avoid her empowered basic attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line, and don’t throw Darius E Apprehend while your vision is reduced. Don’t engage first while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.build: Quinn’s damage is mostly physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps first and build armor. Then survive with Dead Man’s Plate or Randuin’s Omen, slowing Quinn when you get close so you can chase her.
Quinn.fight: Early on, avoid trades that cost you health within Quinn’s range. Start a damage trade by pulling her with Darius E Apprehend when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit her with the blade and get damage and healing.
Quinn.laning: Hold the wave near your side to make Quinn walk up to farm. Farm when Quinn P Harrier isn’t marking you, and stand behind the minion line to avoid the vision reduction from Quinn Q Blinding Assault. If you push the wave, secure vision first to prepare for ganks.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → step back and use Darius Q Decimate. To look for an execute, build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage. Save Darius E Apprehend until then; pull Quinn when she steps back and attack while she has no escape.
Quinn.phase: Lock in your advantage during your strong mid-game window, and avoid forcing direct engages in the late game.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn enters from the flank, catch her with Darius E Apprehend and attack with your team. In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Renekton.watch: If Renekton’s P Reign of Anger bar is above half or just below it, stay out of range and watch for the stun from his empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash if it hits a unit, so don’t stand in or behind a group of minions.
Renekton.build: Renekton’s main damage is physical, so rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor. Survive with Dead Man’s Plate or Randuin’s Omen while slowing Renekton when he’s close. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek turns fights around, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury, and keep your distance when he has enough to empower an ability. If you survive his first combo after he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice, counterattack. Right after Renekton E Slice and Dice is used to disengage, pull him with Darius E Apprehend and continue the extended fight.
Renekton.laning: Freeze the wave near your side to make Renekton walk up to farm, and pressure him within Darius E Apprehend range. Don’t stand in or behind a group of minions and give him a setup for Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you push the wave, secure vision first.
Renekton.combo: After Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade and get damage and healing. To execute, build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Renekton.escape: Engage right after making Renekton use Renekton E Slice and Dice. In particular, if he used it to disengage, pull him back with Darius E Apprehend and cut off his escape. The best window to counterattack is after Renekton W Ruthless Predator and his other abilities are down.
Renekton.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal and sustain through the fight. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to keep resetting its cooldown.

Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are used for chained dashes, so move back when you see the first dash to reduce the distance of the remaining dashes. Riven W Ki Burst stuns when she gets close, and Riven R Blade of the Exile increases her range while active. Keep your distance because its execute damage scales with your missing health.
Riven.build: Riven deals mostly physical damage, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor. If Riven gets ahead, buy Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen early as well, and use the slow while you stay close to her to hold your ground.
Riven.fight: Engage after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, or after she has used Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. If Riven engages first, use Darius E Apprehend to interrupt the rest of her combo, then weave attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage.
Riven.laning: Freeze the lane on your side so Riven has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. Punish her as soon as she uses Riven Q Broken Wings on the wave. If you push the lane, secure vision first so Darius, who has no escape mobility, does not get caught by a gank.
Riven.combo: After Riven's dashes are down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → step back and use Darius Q Decimate. For an execute, build enough stacks in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Riven.escape: Do not go in just because one charge of Riven Q Broken Wings is down; check whether she has also used Riven E Valor. In particular, while Riven Q Broken Wings is still on cooldown and Riven W Ki Burst is also down, pull her with Darius E Apprehend to stop her escape.
Riven.phase: In the late game, prioritize side lane pressure because it is hard to engage in a front-to-back team fight.
Riven.teamfight: In narrow terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap Darius Q Decimate's blade on them to heal and stay alive.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett takes damage. After dealing heavy damage, briefly create some distance. When Sett W Haymaker comes out, sidestep the center of its targeting line to avoid the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so do not stand on the opposite side of a minion wave.
Sett.build: Given Sett's main damage, buy Plated Steelcaps first and build armor. Then use Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen to slow Sett while you stay close. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Sett.fight: When Sett R The Show Stopper is down, start a fight by catching him with Darius E Apprehend. Weave attacks and abilities to stack Darius P Hemorrhage, but briefly create distance right after dealing heavy damage to Sett to watch for Sett W Haymaker. Step back as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade and get damage and healing.
Sett.laning: Freeze the lane on your side so Sett has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. Position yourself so you are not between Sett and a group of minions, avoiding the stun condition for Sett E Facebreaker. If you push the lane, secure vision before moving forward since Darius has no escape mobility.
Sett.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. For an execute, stack Darius P Hemorrhage in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. When Sett W Haymaker comes out, avoid the center, then re-engage.
Sett.escape: Use Darius E Apprehend to pull Sett right after he moves with Sett R The Show Stopper. Engage from a position where you can avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker.
Sett.phase: Darius is strong through the mid game, so secure a lane advantage during that time. In the late game, pressure side lanes instead of taking front-to-back team fights.
Sett.teamfight: In narrow terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap Darius Q Decimate's blade on them to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to keep its cooldown reset going.

Rumble.watch: If you get hit by both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, the slow becomes much stronger and your magic resistance is reduced. After the first shot hits, immediately create distance to dodge the second. Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your max health while you stay close, so do not linger near Rumble when you are at a disadvantage.
Rumble.build: Since the opponent's damage is mainly magic, buy Mercury's Treads first, followed by Force of Nature. This reduces the time you are slowed by Rumble E Electro Harpoon and gives you magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only increase your health.
Rumble.fight: If Rumble has activated Rumble W Scrap Shield, save your burst damage until the shield disappears, then catch him with Darius E Apprehend after the movement speed boost ends. For a short trade, stack Darius P Hemorrhage with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back slightly and hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate. When you can execute, build enough Darius P Hemorrhage stacks before using Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Rumble.combo: Use this basic trade order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Do not use Darius Q Decimate while right next to the opponent; step back slightly and hit with the blade. For an execute, build stacks in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Rumble.escape: The opportunity to engage comes after you dodge the second shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble has also used Rumble W Scrap Shield. Rumble has no mobility, so after the shield disappears, pull him with Darius E Apprehend and follow with the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike to maintain distance.
Rumble.teamfight: Look for a chance to pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend in narrow terrain instead of rushing from the front toward the back line. Hit several enemies with the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal, and use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to try to reset its cooldown.

Singed.build: Singed's main damage is magic, so buy Mercury's Treads first, followed by Force of Nature. Mercury's Treads reduce your immobilized time and help prevent your Darius combo from being interrupted.
Singed.fight: When Singed enters Darius E Apprehend range to farm, pull him in and fight. Slow him with Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back and hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate. While Singed R Insanity Potion is active, account for the healing reduction from the poison, and stop chasing if you do not have enough damage to finish him.
Singed.laning: Keep the lane on your side so Singed has to come in to farm, then catch him with Darius E Apprehend to pressure him into recalling. If you push the lane, secure vision before moving forward.
Singed.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. For an execute, stack Darius P Hemorrhage in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → basic attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Adjust your spacing so you do not use Darius Q Decimate while right next to Singed.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so avoid areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive and look for a chance to catch him after Singed E Fling is down. Then pull him with Darius E Apprehend and slow him with Darius W Crippling Strike to maintain distance. Before using Darius R Noxian Guillotine to close the gap, check that there is no adhesive underfoot.
Singed.teamfight: Do not chase Singed all the way when he runs at you; attack his allies while he is held by Darius E Apprehend. In narrow terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap Darius Q Decimate's blade on them to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to keep its cooldown reset going.

Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, Shen Q Twilight Assault empowers his basic attacks, so look for a chance to counterattack right after dodging the dash. When Shen casts Q Twilight Assault, move out of the Spirit Blade’s return path. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears, hold your basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then attack again after it ends.
Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to counter Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t stack resistance in only one category. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so heavily stacking health is a low priority.
Shen.fight: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and mix basic attacks with abilities to build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks. Step back before using Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get the damage and healing.
Shen.laning: Keep the lane on your side so you can pressure Shen with Darius E Apprehend when he walks up to farm. If you push the lane and advance, secure vision first to prepare for a gank.
Shen.combo: Once Shen E Shadow Dash is down and Shen W Spirit's Refuge has ended, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. For an execute, use Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine after building enough P Hemorrhage stacks.
Shen.escape: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage with Darius E Apprehend. If Shen can also use R Stand United, don’t chase too far just because E Shadow Dash is down. In particular, before Shen R Stand United comes back, engage during the window when Shen E Shadow Dash is also down and catch him with Darius E Apprehend.
Shen.teamfight: Tell your team immediately if Shen leaves lane or starts channeling R Stand United. Instead of engaging head-on, use Darius E Apprehend to pull multiple enemies together in narrow terrain, then overlap the blade hits from Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Sion.fight: Bait out or dodge the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side, then start a fight. When Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus damage on him immediately to break the shield and prevent the explosion. In a fight, mix basic attacks and abilities to build Darius P Hemorrhage, and step back before using Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and heals you.
Sion.laning: Freeze the lane on your side so Sion has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. Sion gains maximum health whenever he kills a unit, so don’t keep allowing him to farm; if needed, push to disrupt his farming or create an advantage in another lane. If you push the lane, secure vision before applying pressure because Darius has limited escape options.
Sion.combo: After Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. To execute, build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t use Q right next to Sion; step half a pace back so the blade hits.
Sion.phase: During your strong stretch through the mid game, deny Sion farm and secure a lane advantage.
Sion.teamfight: In narrow terrain, use Darius E Apprehend to pull multiple enemies together, overlap the blade hits from Q Decimate, and heal to sustain yourself. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain; if it hits a wall, it stuns and its cooldown is greatly reduced. Fight in open space rather than with your back to a wall, and if you’re hit against a wall, retreat while accounting for his next dash. Skarner R Impale suppresses you, and the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval are dangerous at close range, so don’t recklessly approach first.
Skarner.laning: Freeze the lane on your side to make Skarner walk up to farm. If you’re with your back to a wall, Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can stun you, so look for a chance to use Darius E Apprehend in open space. If you push the lane, secure vision first because Darius has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. To execute, build enough Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t use Darius Q Decimate right next to your opponent; adjust your spacing so the blade hits.
Skarner.escape: The window to engage opens right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to close the distance, then Darius E Apprehend to pull Skarner in. If Skarner R Impale is still available, watch where you could be suppressed and which direction you could be pulled before engaging.
Skarner.phase: Secure a lane advantage during your strong stretch through the mid game, and use your early lead and objectives to delay Skarner’s tank item purchases.
Skarner.teamfight: In narrow terrain, use Darius E Apprehend to pull multiple enemies together, overlap the blade hits from Darius Q Decimate, and heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to chain a cooldown reset. Be careful where you stand near the edges of the dragon or Baron pit, since Skarner R Impale can pull you inside.

Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so if you’re hit, use abilities instead of basic attacks or retreat. Avoid short trades where Teemo E Toxic Shot can apply its poison, and check paths where Teemo R Noxious Trap may be with Oracle Lens. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth in unwarded brush.
Teemo.build: Since the damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap is mostly magic, buy Mercury's Treads first. Then build magic resistance with Force of Nature.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Pull him in with Darius E Apprehend, stick to him with basic attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back so the blade from Darius Q Decimate hits. If you can’t get on him, avoid short trades where you only take damage from Teemo E Toxic Shot.
Teemo.laning: Hold the lane on your side so Teemo has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. Avoid unwarded brush, and counterattack after Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth breaks. If you push and advance with your jungler, secure vision first to prepare for a gank.
Teemo.combo: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, trade with Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate.
