To execute, build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t force basic attacks while blinded.
Teemo.escape: Engage after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Teemo W Move Quick boosts his movement speed to help him escape, so pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and use the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike to maintain distance.
Teemo.teamfight: Before objectives and in narrow passages, anticipate Teemo R Noxious Trap and use Oracle Lens to check key paths. In narrow terrain, use Darius E Apprehend to pull multiple enemies together, hit them with the blade from Darius Q Decimate, and heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can certainly kill to aim for a cooldown reset.

TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. A third attack or a hit from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash opens the way for a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive’s animation, spread out from your allies to avoid the area knock-up.
TahmKench.build: Since most of Tahm Kench’s damage is magic, buy Mercury’s Treads to reduce the time you spend immobilized and Force of Nature to increase your magic resistance. If the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin becomes a problem in a long duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Darius’s main source of physical damage is easily blocked by Tahm Kench’s high armor, so make use of penetration and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin turns damage taken into a shield or healing, so fight when you can commit to an all-in rather than trading a little damage and backing off. When Tahm Kench has no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and quickly stack Darius P Hemorrhage with a mix of attacks and abilities. Account for Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s shield and healing, then finish with Darius R Noxian Guillotine if you can secure the kill.
TahmKench.laning: Keep the lane on your side so you can pull Tahm Kench in with Darius E Apprehend when he walks up to last-hit. Step back slightly as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade and get its damage and healing. If you push the lane, secure vision first.
TahmKench.combo: When you can confidently kill Tahm Kench, use Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Use Darius W Crippling Strike right after an attack to stack Darius P Hemorrhage quickly, and step back half a step to hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to finish after building enough stacks.
TahmKench.escape: Once Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, giving you a chance to catch him with Darius E Apprehend. Go in when Tahm Kench has no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks; if it has stacked twice, back off while avoiding Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash’s stun angle. If you need to retreat from a losing fight, use the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike.
TahmKench.phase: Lock in your lane advantage during your strong window through mid game, but fight only when you have an opening to finish the duel because of Tahm Kench’s healing and shields.
TahmKench.teamfight: Target the carry Tahm Kench is protecting rather than spending your damage on him first, but account for the possibility that Tahm Kench R Devour can prevent the kill while it is available. In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade hits from Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to go for a chain of kills.

Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury is stacked, his critical strikes become dangerous, so keep your distance while he builds Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown is reduced whenever he critically strikes, so don’t chase him where there are lots of minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t be killed, so hold Darius R Noxian Guillotine, create distance, and wait it out.
Tryndamere.build: Most of Tryndamere’s damage is physical and relies on critical strikes, so buy Plated Steelcaps first to increase your armor. Then consider Randuin’s Omen or Dead Man’s Plate. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust turns fights around, slot Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Tryndamere.laning: In the early game, harass Tryndamere to keep him from building Fury with last hits. Freeze the lane on your side to draw him in for minions, and look for Darius E Apprehend after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used. If you push the lane, secure vision first because Darius has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks.
Tryndamere.combo: After Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used, trade with Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. For an execute, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Do not use Darius R Noxian Guillotine while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active.
Tryndamere.escape: Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is his means of movement, so right after he uses it is your chance to catch him with Darius E Apprehend. When Tryndamere runs away, use the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike to stay in range. If you are hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, your attack damage is reduced, so don’t immediately start trading attacks.
Tryndamere.phase: Lock in your lane advantage during your strong window through mid game. Since it’s hard to engage in a straight-on team fight late game, choose to pressure a side lane unless you have favorable terrain.
Tryndamere.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade hits from Darius Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to aim for a cooldown reset. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t try to execute him; create distance and wait it out.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and basic attacks, and consider options that reduce his attack speed. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking only resistances or health. If Trundle’s healing turns around long fights, slot Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Trundle.fight: Fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain and after the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp has ended. Once you catch him with Darius E Apprehend, build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks with attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back half a step to hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate and heal. If Trundle R Subjugate activates, create distance, then re-engage.
Trundle.laning: Keep the lane on your side so you can look for Darius E Apprehend when Trundle walks up to last-hit. Trundle heals whenever an enemy unit dies thanks to Trundle P King’s Tribute, so instead of harassing him for a long time while a large wave clashes, capitalize as soon as you’ve chipped away at his health or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.combo: For a standard trade, use Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius W Crippling Strike to reset your attack, then finish with Darius Q Decimate, stepping back half a step to hit with the blade. For an execute, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine, then finish.
Trundle.escape: The opening to engage comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is used and Trundle W Frozen Domain’s duration ends. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Darius R Noxian Guillotine and catch him with Darius E Apprehend. If the pillar is placed in a narrow passage, immediately move to the side to get out first.
Trundle.teamfight: In tight terrain, you can heal and stay alive by pulling multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlapping the blade hits from Darius Q Decimate. If Trundle R Subjugate is active on you, create distance or attack another target. Start with a target you can reliably kill and use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to go for a cooldown reset.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes in and stuns, so be careful right after he activates the stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm also slows. If you’ve already taken a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, fight back or retreat while he can’t stun the same target again.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone can’t block all his damage. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle turns around long fights, slot Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Udyr.fight: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is used and its Awakened effect ends, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend to start the fight. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield expires, press the attack with a mix of attacks and abilities to build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks. Step back slightly to hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate for damage and healing.
Udyr.laning: Keep the lane on your side so you can get in range for Darius E Apprehend when the enemy walks up to last-hit. Udyr may appear from the jungle to gank, so secure vision around key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward when he’s out of sight. If you push the lane, secure vision first.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is used and its Awakened effect ends, trade with Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. For an execute, build stacks with Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Step back half a step as you use Darius Q Decimate to hit with the blade, and use Darius R Noxian Guillotine after building enough stacks.
Udyr.escape: Right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is used is your chance to go in. If you’ve already taken a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have time to fight back, but immobilizing effects don’t work during his Awakened state, so use Darius E Apprehend after it ends. If you need to close the gap, you can approach with Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Udyr.phase: Secure your lane advantage during your strong window through mid game.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force a kill on Udyr when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; take out the weaker enemies behind him first. In tight terrain, pull multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade hits from Darius Q Decimate to heal. Start with a target you can reliably kill with Darius R Noxian Guillotine to go for a cooldown reset.

Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid staying near Urgot for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, its heavy slow lets Urgot W Purge focus its fire on you. Dodge it as it comes in; if it already hit, decide whether to fight back rather than trying to walk away at all costs. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so prioritize Plated Steelcaps and armor. Hold your ground with Dead Man’s Plate or Randuin’s Omen, while keeping your distance even after Urgot uses Urgot E Disdain. Darius E Apprehend already has armor penetration, so don’t invest too heavily in penetration items alone.
Urgot.fight: Fight with Darius E Apprehend as soon as Urgot E Disdain is down. Mix attacks and abilities to quickly stack Darius P Hemorrhage, and step back slightly when using Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, walk out of its firing range first.
Urgot.laning: Hold the wave near your side so Urgot has to walk up to farm. Catch him with Darius E Apprehend when Urgot E Disdain is down. If you push the wave, secure vision first so Darius, who has no mobility ability, doesn’t get caught by a gank.
Urgot.combo: After Urgot E Disdain is down, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate.
Urgot.escape: The opening to engage is right after Urgot’s mobility tool, Urgot E Disdain, is down. If you need to close the gap, use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to approach, then pull him in with Darius E Apprehend so he can’t get away. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits and makes it hard to escape on foot, you can use Darius R Noxian Guillotine as a mobility tool.
Urgot.phase: During your strong window through mid game, take advantage of Urgot E Disdain being down to secure a lane advantage.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand on the front line to keep it from catching the damage dealers behind you. In narrow terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Start with targets you can certainly kill using Darius R Noxian Guillotine to chain cooldown resets.

Volibear.watch: When Volibear approaches with Volibear Q Thundering Smash active, watch for the stun on his empowered basic attack and wait outside attack range. When you see the marker for Volibear E Sky Splitter, walk to the side to avoid its damage and slow, and check where he plans to get the shield. If Volibear has built up Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks by hitting minions, don’t take a fight.
Volibear.build: Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing can turn a prolonged fight, so slot Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health.
Volibear.laning: Freeze the wave near your side so Volibear has to enter Darius E Apprehend range to farm. If he builds Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks by hitting minions, back away and fight after the stacks fall off. If you push the wave, secure vision first because Darius has no mobility ability to escape with.
Volibear.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To execute, stack P Hemorrhage in this order: Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t use Darius Q Decimate right next to Volibear; position so the blade hits.
Volibear.escape: Engage during the window when Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun is down and R Stormbringer is also unavailable. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can still escape with R Stormbringer, so don’t rush to use Darius E Apprehend.
Volibear.teamfight: In narrow terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Target enemies you can certainly kill with Darius R Noxian Guillotine to aim for cooldown resets. If your health is low and Volibear R Stormbringer is still available, don’t stay under the turret; retreat deeper into your base.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist lowers armor, slows, and deals damage based on maximum health, so watch its arc and dodge it. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it. When the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.build: Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage, so build armor first. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites can turn a prolonged fight, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Yorick.fight: Clear Yorick’s Mist Walkers first, and don’t start a fight where many graves have accumulated. After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, if Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, catch him with Darius E Apprehend and stack P Hemorrhage. Step back slightly when using Darius Q Decimate so the blade hits and you get its damage and healing.
Yorick.laning: Push the wave toward the enemy turret so Yorick can’t build graves by clearing minions on his side. Secure vision while pushing to prepare for ganks. If there are few graves and you can keep the wave near your side, look for Darius E Apprehend when Yorick walks up to farm.
Yorick.combo: For a short trade, use Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. To go for an execution, fill P Hemorrhage stacks in this order: Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Don’t use Darius Q Decimate right next to your opponent; position so the blade hits.
Yorick.escape: The moment after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist is your chance to advance. If Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, catch him with Darius E Apprehend and use the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike to maintain distance.
Yorick.teamfight: In narrow terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on targets you can certainly kill to chain executions with its cooldown reset.

Yone.watch: Yone repeatedly hits minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel before dashing in with the tornado, so keep your distance until its stacks expire once the tornado is ready. When he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, you may take extra damage when he returns, so look to heal with the blade of Darius Q Decimate before your health gets low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so just before a team fight, make sure you aren’t alone at the very back of your formation.
Yone.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of Yone’s telegraphed attack range. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t stack resistance in only one category. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health. Darius E Apprehend already has armor penetration, so items that heavily invest in penetration are a lower priority.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance while Yone’s tornado Q is ready, and look for Darius E Apprehend after he uses his escape tools: Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, and R Fate Sealed. If Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, you have a chance to stop his return with the crowd control from Darius E Apprehend. Once you pull him in, stack P Hemorrhage with attacks and Darius W Crippling Strike, then step back slightly and hit with the blade of Darius Q Decimate.
Yone.laning: Keep the wave near your side so Yone has to walk up to farm, then look for Darius E Apprehend range right after he uses a mobility ability. If you push the wave, secure vision before advancing because Darius has no mobility ability to escape with.
Yone.combo: After tracking Yone’s mobility abilities, use this basic trade order: Darius E Apprehend → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate. Use Darius W Crippling Strike immediately after an attack, and step back slightly so the blade of Darius Q Decimate hits. To execute, stack P Hemorrhage in this order: Darius E Apprehend → attack → attack → Darius W Crippling Strike → Darius Q Decimate → attack → Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Yone.escape: If only one of Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, or R Fate Sealed is down, he can escape with another mobility ability, so don’t rush to use Darius E Apprehend. In particular, look for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back, and pull him in with Darius E Apprehend right after he uses a mobility ability. If he dives in first with Yone E Soul Unbound, hold Darius E Apprehend to stop his return.
Yone.phase: Both champions have a weak early game, but pressure Yone when his tornado Q isn’t ready to slow his growth.
Yone.teamfight: Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield grows as it hits more champions, so don’t stand clumped with your allies. In narrow terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and overlap the blade of Darius Q Decimate to try to heal. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on targets you can certainly kill to chain cooldown resets.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so when he approaches, step out of his line and dodge to the side. If Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice and prepares a tornado, watch for the sound and visual effect and be ready for the knock-up. Also watch for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, which he uses to dash in through minions.
Yasuo.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps first to increase your armor against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Then endure with Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen while slowing Yasuo when he stays close. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light damage first, then commit to the trade. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, creating an opening to engage. When Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is on cooldown, pull him in with Darius E Apprehend and build P Hemorrhage stacks.
Yasuo.combo: After Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is on cooldown, trade in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate. Step back as Darius Q Decimate lands so the blade hits and you deal damage and heal. To execute, build stacks and finish in this order: Darius E Apprehend → basic attack → basic attack → W Crippling Strike → Q Decimate → basic attack → R Noxian Guillotine.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an opening right after Yasuo throws his tornado, but do not immediately go deep just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is on cooldown. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, catch him with Darius E Apprehend while his mobility and knock-up are unavailable. You can use Darius R Noxian Guillotine to close the distance.
Yasuo.teamfight: In tight terrain, pull in multiple enemies with Darius E Apprehend and hit them with the blade of Q Decimate to heal and stay alive. Use Darius R Noxian Guillotine on a target you can reliably kill to try to reset its cooldown. If there is no such terrain, choose side-lane pressure over a front-to-back team fight.
